verdict.statement: The frozen bank is materially source-correct and covers all named board spaces, standard scoring Rival procedures, CHOAM branches and ordinary phase/reward procedures. proposed_additions.question: For an ordinary Agent turn, where must the card you play and the Agent you send come from, where do you put them, and which box of the played card do you resolve? May you instead reuse a card already in play or in your discard pile, or simply move an Agent already on the board?
proposed_additions.predetermined_answer: Play one card from your hand face up in front of you and send one available Agent from your Leader to a legal board space. Gain the board-space effects and the played card’s Agent-box effects, ignoring its Reveal box during the Agent turn; a Faction board space also advances its Influence. Ordinary Agent turns do not let you play a card from your discard pile or reuse an already in-play card, and do not let you simply relocate an Agent already on the board. A separate effect such as Recall Agent can first return an Agent to your Leader for use on a later Agent turn. The ordinary space must be unoccupied, subject to the separately tested Spy exception.
source_references: Main PDF p9 Player Turn—Agent Turn: card from hand face up in front; Agent from Leader to unoccupied space; board-space and Agent-box effects, ignoring Reveal box
Main PDF p20 Recall Agent; tested exception in Q36
proposed_additions.novelty: This tests the ordinary turn’s legal sources and movement, which constrain whether a player can manufacture further Agent turns by reusing placed Agents or played/discarded cards. Q04 requests costs/card capacity/no-icon legality, Q87 requests matching access icons, Q03/Q35 request later lifetime/destinations, and Q36 requests recall reuse. None requests the ordinary origin rule. This is a distinct foundational source rule, not different numbers/names or a recombination of existing cost/access cases. The question also explicitly requests the Agent-box/ignore-Reveal-box part of the same basic procedure; Q03 asks Reveal-side card eligibility, so this makes the Agent side direct without creating a standalone reverse-box variant.
proposed_additions.origin: Ordinary legal-origin rule independently identified by this reviewer. Parent subsequently supplied a source-only suggestion to include the Agent-box/ignore-Reveal-box portion in this same basic-procedure question. Reviewer independently checked p9 and relevant actual questions; no reader/history information used.

proposed_additions.question: Shaddam Corrino IV plays Signet Ring to send an Agent to a Combat space. May he choose to deploy units before Emperor of the Known Universe’s deployment restriction starts by resolving the board-space effects first, or does the restriction already apply when he places the Agent?
proposed_additions.predetermined_answer: The restriction takes effect immediately when Signet Ring is played to place the Agent, so it already applies to deployment on that turn. General freedom to order board-space and Agent-card effects cannot postpone it. The restriction lasts only for the turn in which it was triggered.
source_references: Main PDF p17 Clarifications—Shaddam Corrino IV: restriction takes effect immediately on Signet Ring Agent placement
Main PDF p9 ordinary freedom to order board/card/Influence effects
FAQ PDF p3 Shaddam Corrino IV: only triggered turn, not remaining round
proposed_additions.novelty: Consequential named exception to general Agent-effect ordering: onset has priority over deployment. Q43 requests duration but not onset or ordering; Q72 asks generic Signet activation versus Reveal; Q24 asks normal ordering and pre-entry prerequisites. These do not directly request whether the restriction can be postponed by ordering. This adds an explicitly source-defined timing/priority exception, not another duration or generic Signet variant.
proposed_additions.origin: Parent supplied a source/question-wording-only candidate during review. Reviewer independently verified p17/p9/FAQ and every relevant actual question. No summary, reader performance, repair history or earlier reviewer conclusion was supplied or consulted.
